name: eval-v0.1
description: Draft Bulgarian evaluation package for summarize and claim verification (S1 to S5). Passages P1, P2 and P4 are synthetic demo texts; slot P3 is reserved for an EUR-Lex-Sum Bulgarian reference text that is not sourced yet.
hash_algorithm: sha256 over the raw UTF-8 bytes of the passage file
token_count_method: ceil(characters / 3), a rough estimate for Cyrillic text
